Redirected design per Jack Heart (2026-11-26): do not patch around synchronous 1-match play(match). Completely separate the play-match API: make it fully asynchronous (async def play with zero-delay barrier flushing) AND provide a play_many / streaming batch-stepping contract so vectorized engines like Manabot (RolloutPool/VectorEnv, MTG-497) and PufferLib can step hundreds of games natively, backfill finished slots without stragglers, submit pre-collated batches, and yield (match, Result) asynchronously while Etude owns scheduling, checkpoint residency/LRU, durable results, and failure isolation.
